finding: Unbound served a stale cached answer immediately after the authoritative change was promoted, while CoreDNS-forwarder (uncached) reflected the change instantly; Unbound reconverged only after its cache TTL elapsed.
measurement_note: propagation_lag_measured_s is a first-observation measurement from ~1s-interval polling of Unbound starting after promotion. propagation_lag_predicted_from_ttl_s is the independent mechanistic prediction (cache entry populated at pre_unbound_query, cache_ttl_s TTL, minus elapsed time to change_promoted); the two should agree within one poll interval.
